name: print-social-halftone-folder-banner-launch
title: Blue halftone banner with a 'target launch' folder and white scribble
whatItIs: A wide banner with blue and grey halftone dots. A manila folder labelled 'target launch' in serif sits in the middle with a cursor, a white brush burst behind, and app icons (Photoshop, Figma, Illustrator, Procreate, a spark) around.
whatItMeans: Nostalgic desktop and creator-tool energy; the halftone gives a print-like warmth to digital icons.
techniques: Put the category name on a folder tab so a banner works as a label.
Apply coarse halftone in a blue palette over an abstract gradient.
Add a white gestural scribble behind the folder.
Surround with tool icons to signal skills.

vocabulary.definition: An image or gradient made of a dot grid.
A serif title on a manila folder graphic.
App logos arranged around a central object.
